grub_cfg:
set timeout=-1
set default=0
set pager=1

insmod part_gpt
insmod part_msdos
insmod search_fs_file
insmod search_fs_uuid
insmod fat
insmod ext2
insmod btrfs
insmod xfs
insmod regexp
insmod configfile
insmod chain
insmod search
insmod search_label
insmod probe
insmod test

insmod cryptodisk
insmod crypto
insmod luks2
insmod argon2
insmod gcry_rijndael
insmod gcry_sha512
insmod gcry_sha256
insmod gcry_rsa
insmod pgp
search --no-floppy --fs-uuid --set=trust_root BOOT-ASSETS-UUID
trust --skip-sig (${trust_root})/secureboot/grub-signing.pub
set check_signatures=enforce

                            set check_signatures=no

                            chainloader "${debian_usb_selected_device}${debian_usb_selected_path}"
                            boot
                            echo "Internal UEFI loader failed: ${debian_usb_selected_device}${debian_usb_selected_path}"
                            if [ -n "${debian_usb_entry_previous_check_signatures}" ]; then
                                set check_signatures="${debian_usb_entry_previous_check_signatures}"
                            else
                                set check_signatures=
                            fi
                        }
                    fi
                    if [ -f "${debian_usb_internal_dev}/EFI/ubuntu/shimx64.efi" ]; then
                        set debian_usb_internal_found=1
                        menuentry "Ubuntu Secure Boot shim on ${debian_usb_internal_label_text}" "${debian_usb_internal_dev}" "/EFI/ubuntu/shimx64.efi" {
                            set debian_usb_selected_device="${2}"
                            set debian_usb_selected_path="${3}"

                            echo "Chainloading ${debian_usb_selected_path} from ${debian_usb_selected_device}."
                            chainloader "${debian_usb_selected_device}${debian_usb_selected_path}"
                            boot
                            echo "Internal UEFI loader failed: ${debian_usb_selected_device}${debian_usb_selected_path}"
                            if [ -n "${debian_usb_entry_previous_check_signatures}" ]; then
                                set check_signatures="${debian_usb_entry_previous_check_signatures}"
                            else
                                set check_signatures=
                            fi
                        }
                    fi
                    if [ -f "${debian_usb_internal_dev}/EFI/ubuntu/grubx64.efi" ]; then
                        set debian_usb_internal_found=1
                        menuentry "Ubuntu GRUB on ${debian_usb_internal_label_text}" "${debian_usb_internal_dev}" "/EFI/ubuntu/grubx64.efi" {
                            set debian_usb_selected_device="${2}"
                            set debian_usb_selected_path="${3}"
                            set debian_usb_entry_previous_check_signatures="${check_signatures}"

                            if [ -n "${debian_usb_entry_previous_check_signatures}" ]; then
                                set check_signatures="${debian_usb_entry_previous_check_signatures}"
                            else
                                set check_signatures=
                            fi
                        }
                    fi
                    if [ -f "${debian_usb_internal_dev}/EFI/kali/grubx64.efi" ]; then
                        set debian_usb_internal_found=1
                        menuentry "Kali GRUB on ${debian_usb_internal_label_text}" "${debian_usb_internal_dev}" "/EFI/kali/grubx64.efi" {
                            set debian_usb_selected_device="${2}"
                            set debian_usb_selected_path="${3}"

                            echo "Chainloading ${debian_usb_selected_path} from ${debian_usb_selected_device}."

                    fi
                fi
            fi
        fi
    done

    if [ -n "${debian_usb_scan_previous_check_signatures}" ]; then
        set check_signatures="${debian_usb_scan_previous_check_signatures}"
    else
        set check_signatures=
    fi

    if [ "${debian_usb_internal_found}" = "0" ]; then
        menuentry "No internal drive boot entries detected" {

menuentry "MOK Enrollment" {
    insmod chain
    search --no-floppy --fs-uuid --set=root BOOT-ASSETS-UUID
    echo Loading signed MokManager.
    if chainloader /EFI/debian-usb/mok/mmx64.efi; then
        boot
    fi
    echo Direct MokManager launch failed - trying shim fallback.
    chainloader /EFI/debian-usb/mok/shimx64.efi
    boot
}

submenu "UEFI Keys" {
    menuentry "UEFI Keys User Mode (PK Installed) [.auth]" {
        insmod chain
        search --no-floppy --fs-uuid --set=root BOOT-ASSETS-UUID
        echo Loading UpdateVars with authenticated db update.
        chainloader /EFI/debian-usb/updatevars/UpdateVars.efi -a db /secureboot/db.auth
        boot
    }

    menuentry "UEFI Keys Setup Mode (PK Not Installed) [.esl]" {
        insmod chain
        search --no-floppy --fs-uuid --set=root BOOT-ASSETS-UUID
        echo Loading UpdateVars with db EFI Signature List.
        chainloader /EFI/debian-usb/updatevars/UpdateVars.efi -a -e db /secureboot/db.esl
        boot
    }
}
